title: A Hurricane Killed 6,000. So They Lifted a Whole City

scenes.text: A hurricane killed six thousand people. Then they lifted the whole city.
On September 8, 1900, a storm surge of nearly sixteen feet destroyed about a third of Galveston, Texas.
First came a seawall over three miles long. Then something crazier.
Workers raised about two thousand buildings with hand-turned jackscrews.
Then sixteen million cubic yards of sand lifted parts of the city up to seventeen feet.
A hurricane killed six thousand, so a whole city rose out of reach.

description:
After the 1900 hurricane killed at least 6,000 people, Galveston, Texas, raised the city with a seawall and millions of cubic yards of sand.
About 2,000 buildings were jacked up, and parts of the city rose as much as 17 feet.
Would you have stayed?
first_comment: Would you rebuild a city in the same place after a disaster like this?
